meta.name: edgeone-makers-storage
meta.description: KV and Blob storage services on EdgeOne Makers. KV for edge key-value pairs, Blob for file/object storage in Cloud Functions. Covers SDK usage, setup, and troubleshooting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在EdgeOne平台上使用KV或Blob存储服务。
copy.tagline_en: Read and write KV and Blob storage on EdgeOne
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use KV or Blob storage on EdgeOne platform.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你使用 EdgeOne Makers 的 KV 和 Blob 存储服务。KV 用于边缘函数中的小键值对，Blob 用于云函数中的文件对象。
howto.when: 当你需要为 EdgeOne Makers 项目选择或配置持久化存储时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 KV 存储一个用户会话令牌。
say.note: Claude 会指导你使用全局变量操作 KV。

say.text: 如何用 Blob 存储上传用户头像？
say.note: Claude 会介绍 Blob SDK 和文件上传步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use EdgeOne Makers' KV and Blob storage services. KV is for small key-value pairs in Edge Functions, Blob for files/objects in Cloud Functions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to select or configure persistent storage for an EdgeOne Makers project.

say_en.text: Help me store a user session token using KV.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on using global variables for KV.

say_en.text: How to store user avatars using Blob?
say_en.note: Claude will introduce Blob SDK and file upload steps.
